_comment: A0 anchor: original HF endpoint (hf_endpoint_mode=raw), batch 96, 15-epoch cosine kept uncompressed, stop externally after epoch 4.

ablation.name: A0_hf_b96
ablation.notes: Anchor reproduction of the historical ~1M WEAVE band-FM route. Fixed split: 900 train / 100 val per style (prefix/suffix of sorted stems). 15-epoch cosine is NOT compressed; training is stopped after epoch 4 by the operator.
